entities.name: Étienne Gnassingbé Eyadéma
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gnassingbé Eyadéma was a Togolese military officer and politician who served as the third president of Togo from 1967 until his death in 2005, after which he was immediately succeeded by his son, Faure Gnassingbé.
